name: Generator & Battery Rebate
description: Up to $300 rebate on a portable generator or battery for outage preparedness, plus up to $200 more for CARE/FERA customers; must be in a high fire-threat area or on an EPSS circuit
fullDescription: PG&E provides rebates for portable generators and batteries to help customers in high fire-risk areas prepare for power outages during Public Safety Power Shutoffs and other wildfire safety outages.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $300 rebate on a qualifying portable generator or portable battery
- Up to $200 extra for CARE or FERA customers
- For customers in Tier 2 or 3 High Fire-Threat Districts, High Fire Risk Areas, or on EPSS circuits
- Open to residential and business accounts
- Generators must be CARB-compliant and on PG&E's qualified product list; batteries must be 290-1,000 Wh
howToGetIt:
1. Check if your address qualifies on PG&E's Wildfire Safety Progress Map
2. Purchase a qualifying new generator or battery (no used, refurbished, rented, or leased items)
3. Wait until the product is delivered
4. Apply online within 12 months of purchase, and no later than December 31, 2026
5. Submit proof of purchase and delivery
keywords: generator, battery, rebate, PG&E, PSPS, EPSS, power outage, fire, CARE, FERA, backup power
